description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called FragmentNestingTabs that demonstrates the use of action bar tabs and their interaction with fragments. It includes an internal static class TabListener that handles tab selection events and manages fragment transactions to switch between different fragment views within the activity.

classes.name: FragmentNestingTabs
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating tab navigation with fragments.

classes.name: FragmentNestingTabs.TabListener
classes.description: A generic tab listener that manages fragment transactions upon tab selection, unselection, and reselection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the action bar tabs, and restores saved state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current selected tab index for state restoration.

methods.name: TabListener (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a new TabListener, checks for existing fragments with the given tag to manage fragment state.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection by attaching or creating the associated fragment.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Handles tab unselection by detaching the associated fragment.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Handles reselection of a tab, in this case showing a toast message.
